prompts: Wide shot of misty forest at dawn, soft golden light filtering through ancient trees, camera static, peaceful atmosphere, cinematic 4k
Camera slowly moves forward through the forest path, revealing a small clearing with wildflowers, gentle movement, serene mood
Close-up of morning dew on vibrant green leaves, bokeh background with soft light rays, macro detail, tranquil scene
Aerial view of ocean waves crashing on rocky shore, dramatic sunset colors, smooth drone movement, epic landscape

test_cases.name: Single Prompt with Target Duration (30s)

payload.prompt: Medium shot of vintage record player spinning, warm amber lighting, vinyl texture visible, static camera with shallow depth of field, nostalgic atmosphere, 4k

curl_examples.multi_prompt:
curl -X POST https://kling-video-service-production.up.railway.app/generate-video \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "prompts": [
      "Scene 1: Forest at dawn",
      "Scene 2: Path through trees",
      "Scene 3: Close-up of leaves"
    ],
    "model_name": "kling-v2-6",
    "duration": "10",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
    "mode": "pro"
  }'
